results.steps: Choose 3 PDFs
results.expected: 3 rows; count shows files, pages, size

results.steps: Click ↓ on row 1
results.expected: Order r2, r1, r3

results.steps: Click ↑ on row 3
results.expected: Order r2, r3, r1

results.steps: Inspect first/last row buttons
results.expected: ↑ disabled on first row, ↓ disabled on last row

results.steps: Type output name with illegal characters, merge, download
results.expected: Illegal characters replaced; .pdf added once

results.steps: Check merged page order after reordering
results.expected: Pages in on-screen order (r2, r3, r1 → widths 320, 330, 310)

results.steps: Clear output name, merge again
results.expected: Default name ASEC-merged-YYYYMMDD-HHMM.pdf

results.steps: Click ✕ on row 2
results.expected: Row removed; result cleared

results.steps: Click "Clear all"
results.expected: List empty; empty-state text shown; buttons disabled

results.steps: Drag row 3 onto row 1 (mouse drag & drop)
results.expected: r3 moves to the top

results.steps: Choose a .txt file
results.expected: Not added; inline message
results.actual: 1 file was not addednotes.txt: not a PDF. Only .pdf files can be merged.

results.steps: Functional session above
results.expected: 0 external requests, 0 CSP violations, no dialogs

results.steps: Inspect storage after a full session
results.expected: No cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB or service worker

results.steps: Add files named .pdf and ">
results.expected: Names shown as literal text; no element injected; no script runs
results.actual: dialogs=0, injected img=0, svg=0, shown: .pdf | ">

results.steps: Add a 0.4 MB PDF whose content stream inflates to 400 MB, plus a normal PDF; merge
results.expected: No crash or hang; merge completes or a clear error
results.actual: thumbnails settled in 1748 ms; merge 70 ms; status "Done ✅ 4 pages • 400.13 KB"; page responsive=true

results.steps: Load the page, go offline, then add 2 files and merge
results.expected: Thumbnails and merge work without a network

results.steps: Reload the page while offline
results.expected: (Informational) No service worker, so a reload needs the server

results.steps: Open the old /asec/ link
results.expected: Redirects to /asec/v2/ (meta refresh, no script)

results.steps: Open with default setting (auto) on localhost
results.expected: Banner hidden (not github.io)

results.steps: Serve index.html with <meta name="kdms-demo-banner" content="off">
results.expected: Banner hidden (production setting)

results.steps: Open index.html by double-click (file://)
results.expected: Warning shown that a web server is needed
results.actual: The app has not started. It must be opened from a web server (e.g. the ASEC intranet link), not by double-clicking index.html, and its files must not be modified.

results.steps: GET http://localhost:8821/asec/v2/ and list response headers
results.expected: (Informational) GitHub Pages cannot set custom headers; CSP comes from the <meta> tag. web.config supplies all 7 headers on IIS
results.actual: present: content-security-policy, x-content-type-options, x-frame-options, referrer-policy, permissions-policy, cross-origin-opener-policy; cache-control: null; server: SimpleHTTP/0.6 Python/3.13.5

results.steps: GET pdfjs-init.mjs
results.expected: Served as JavaScript (module MIME type)

results.steps: SHA-256 of served vendor files vs the files in the official npm tarballs (pdfjs-dist 6.4.299 legacy/build, @cantoo/pdf-lib 2.11.1 dist)
results.expected: Byte-identical
results.actual: pdf.min.mjs match; pdf.worker.min.mjs match; pdf-lib.min.js match

results.steps: Search all shipped JS for eval(
results.expected: No eval( in shipped code; CSP has no unsafe-eval

results.steps: Serve a modified script.js (one extra line) to the page
results.expected: Browser refuses to run it (Subresource Integrity)
results.actual: tampered code ran=false; integrity errors in console=1

results.steps: Keyboard only: Tab to "Choose PDF files" + Enter, pick 2 files, Tab to ↓ + Enter, Tab to Merge + Enter
results.expected: The whole flow works without a mouse; focus is visible
results.actual: Tab→browseBtn, Tab→↓ (focus outline solid), Tab→mergeBtn; file chooser opened=true; order after ↓: r2.pdf, r1.pdf; result=true
